# An invoice with `auto_apply_credit: true` and no `posted:` block.
#
# The owner's credit settles what a posted invoice put on the receivable. This
# invoice is not posted, so there is nothing on the receivable for a credit to
# settle.
#
# What this fixture produces: nothing. The import refuses the invoice.
#
# Verified by tests/integration/test_the_owners_credit_is_refused_for_an_unposted_record.py.
customer "C001"
	name: "Acme"
	currency: CAD

invoice "INV-UNPOSTED-CREDIT"
	customer_id: "C001"
	currency: CAD
	date_opened: 2026-01-01
	auto_apply_credit: true
	entry:
		date: 2026-01-01
		description: "Service"
		action: "Hours"
		account: "Income:Sales"
		quantity: 1
		price: 100
		taxable: false
		tax_included: false
